The [http://www.patriotmemory.com/product/specs/mini-wifi.pdf Spec sheet] says "Compatible with Patriot Memory Alpine Media Player or any other desktop/laptop systems." Some users online have been unable to use this adapter with the Patriot Memory Box Office Media Player.
